purpose: V7 diverse training catalog gate. CIFAR-100 rows enter database_offline_v7_diverse_admitted.json only when status == 'admitted'. Admission = the no-agent mild 2-pass walk under the *V7 train FT* (12/4 with SPECTRA_FT_LR=1e-4, or SGD 0.01 — whichever the C10 control also recovers under) reaches TRAJ val_best with kept <= 0.98 and val dacc >= -tau. The 18-20 Sep gate (ledger 109) used Adam 1e-3 12/4 and admitted nothing; hypothesis: the FT LR, not the nets, is what fails on CIFAR-100.

admit_rule.probe_recipe: mild 2-pass group-once, recipe A, train budget 12/4, FT LR arm chosen by the C10 control
